name: sessions-retro
description: Two-stage retrospective over pi session transcripts for one project: parallel cheap-model per-session digests, then one strong-model synthesis producing a ranked proposal board for the setup. Read-only children; a human decides what to apply. See README.md for limits.

cwd.description: The project whose sessions to review, e.g. /Users/nietaki/repos/grr-fyi (pi stores them under ~/.pi/agent/sessions/--Users-nietaki-repos-grr-fyi--/ - absolute path with '/' replaced by '-')

maxSessions.description: Newest-N session files to digest (capped at 16)
